verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library/SDK with llms.txt, an AI Harness, MCP servers, and agent-skills endpoints, so AI-native users can build against these official interfaces (dlt-docs-14, dlt-docs-58, dlt-docs-61, dlt-probe-1, dlt-probe-4). However, evidence is mostly first-party docs with no independent/hands-on confirmation that these AI-facing SDKs work as advertised, and the OpenAPI/API spec probe returned 404s. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI Harness and MCP servers, a working public OpenAPI spec, and community corroboration specific to AI-agent SDK usage.
